name: Densest Subgraph
shortfall_explanation: The existing CDS source reference lacks a detected redistribution license. Densest-subgraph optimization is not interchangeable with k-core peeling.
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.

algorithms.algorithm_name: Bound-Tightened Densest Subgraph Discovery on GPU
algorithms.notes: The author repository contains the paper's CUDA implementation. For k=2 its k-clique-density objective is ordinary unweighted densest-subgraph density; k=3 and k=4 are higher-order variants.
